method: All 39 PNGs produced by this R6 recipe were opened individually with view_image. Original R6 bytes remain unchanged. R5 images are not reused or relabelled.

observations.finding: All six retained facades remain attached to their local supports. Continuous paving covers both small mausoleum joints. Original doors, native art, foreground transparency and intentional outer relief remain.

All six native props remain grounded with their original scale. The register marker remains to the right of the retained planter; real keyboard walking reaches the original V104 waypoint after the collision check. Existing operator approaches remain free in the executed scenarios.

All seven walkers show complete grounded bodies on their tested lanes, including the upper Reserve viaduct. Existing native left/right banks remain in use; no new role-specific animation or global density completion is asserted.

Officer, mausoleum and archive dialogs open through real interaction. The 390px mobile officer dialog remains within the viewport and scrolls natively. The recovery preview retains both actions and a visible terrain area.

All five cases show preview, accepted local restore and voluntary study/cargo reprise. The actor and the relocated parked object retain separate visible positions; the marker and adjacent public ground remain visible.

openVisualFollowup.finding: Fine dark vertical silhouettes remain visible near dock control, around image x414 and x882. Nearby model probes find retained supported ground; a separate read-only DOM/paint-layer diagnostic is in progress. This review does not identify or fill an unsupported physical hole from the image alone.
The preserved outer relief retains angular dark backgrounds and repeated native motifs. Broader landscape composition, dedicated artwork and suspended natural placements remain open.

limitations: Initial campaign checkpoints, completed First Tracks and pre-owned tool are declared fixtures; the recipe does not certify player travel between every city location or every inherited source requirement.
Existing foreground transparency and large dark exterior cliffs remain visible. The bounded review does not establish every possible camera or occlusion case.
Technical visual inspection does not confer the repository status reserved for human artistic validation.
